_metadata.description: Root cause analysis of 39 fontc_crater 'failed to find targets' failures
_metadata.data_source: https://googlefonts.github.io/fontc_crater/ + code analysis of google-fonts-sources crate + METADATA.pb/config.yaml inspection
_metadata.summary: Most failures are due to config.yaml (override or upstream) referencing source files at paths that do not exist at the METADATA.pb pinned commit. The configs were written for current upstream HEAD, but the commit hash freezes the repo at an older state with different file layout.

discovery_chain: google-fonts-sources crate scans google/fonts for METADATA.pb files
For each family, checks if override config.yaml exists alongside METADATA.pb
If override exists: uses it (config_is_external=true), only needs repo_url + commit from METADATA.pb
If no override: requires config_yaml field in METADATA.pb pointing to config inside upstream repo
fontc_crater clones upstream repo at the pinned commit, resolves source paths from config

config_written_for_head_not_pinned_commi.description: Override config.yaml in google/fonts references source files at paths matching the current upstream HEAD, but METADATA.pb pins an older commit where files had different names or locations.
config_written_for_head_not_pinned_commi.fix_strategy: Either update the pinned commit in METADATA.pb to one where the config paths are valid, or adjust the config.yaml paths to match the pinned commit's file layout.

wrong_paths_in_override_config.fix_strategy: Fix the override config.yaml paths to match actual file locations at the pinned commit.
